DIRECT_11.name: ECO Codes
DIRECT_11.query: '  for r in (select cast(null as varchar2(500)) source_label,m.eco_code,e.description from orac_chess.chess_opening_eco_v m join orac_chess.chess_eco_code_v e on e.eco_code=m.eco_code where m.opening_id=:P11_OPENING_ID order by m.eco_code) loop',

DIRECT_21.name: ECO Codes
DIRECT_21.query: '  for r in (select cast(null as varchar2(500)) source_label,m.eco_code,e.description from orac_chess.chess_gambit_eco_v m join orac_chess.chess_eco_code_v e on e.eco_code=m.eco_code where m.gambit_id=:P21_GAMBIT_ID order by m.eco_code) loop',

RELATED_21.name: Related ECO Codes (context only)
RELATED_21.query: '  for r in (select ''Opening: '' || o.name source_label,m.eco_code,e.description from orac_chess.chess_opening_gambit_v g join orac_chess.chess_opening_v o on o.opening_id=g.opening_id join orac_chess.chess_opening_eco_v m on m.opening_id=o.opening_id join orac_chess.chess_eco_code_v e on e.eco_code=m.eco_code where g.gambit_id=:P21_GAMBIT_ID order by o.name,m.eco_code) loop',

DIRECT_31.name: ECO Codes
DIRECT_31.query: '  for r in (select cast(null as varchar2(500)) source_label,m.eco_code,e.description from orac_chess.chess_variation_eco_v m join orac_chess.chess_eco_code_v e on e.eco_code=m.eco_code where m.variation_id=:P31_VARIATION_ID order by m.eco_code) loop',

RELATED_31.name: Related ECO Codes (context only)
RELATED_31.query: '  for r in (select source_type || '': '' || source_name source_label,eco_code,description from (select ''Variation'' source_type,a.name source_name,m.eco_code,e.description from orac_chess.chess_variation_v a join orac_chess.chess_variation_eco_v m on m.variation_id=a.variation_id join orac_chess.chess_eco_code_v e on e.eco_code=m.eco_code where a.variation_id in (select variation_id from orac_chess.chess_variation_v start with variation_id=(select parent_variation_id from orac_chess.chess_variation_v where variation_id=:P31_VARIATION_ID) connect by nocycle prior parent_variation_id=variation_id) union all select ''Opening'',o.name,m.eco_code,e.description from orac_chess.chess_variation_v v join orac_chess.chess_opening_v o on o.opening_id=v.opening_id join orac_chess.chess_opening_eco_v m on m.opening_id=o.opening_id join orac_chess.chess_eco_code_v e on e.eco_code=m.eco_code where v.variation_id=:P31_VARIATION_ID union all select ''Gambit'',g.name,m.eco_code,e.description from orac_chess.chess_variation_v v join orac_chess.chess_gambit_v g on g.gambit_id=v.gambit_id join orac_chess.chess_gambit_eco_v m on m.gambit_id=g.gambit_id join orac_chess.chess_eco_code_v e on e.eco_code=m.eco_code where v.variation_id=:P31_VARIATION_ID) order by source_type,source_name,eco_code) loop',
